context: Two teens chat about phones and games at a bus stop
purpose: Teach: ケータイ/オタク/あらかじめ/あきらめ/ものすごく/ビックリ/とりわけ/ひたすら

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねぇリク、新しいケータイ買ったの?めっちゃ可愛い!
lines.en: Hey Riku, did you get a new phone? It's super cute!
lines.style: Bright excited teen girl voice, rising tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、昨日。あらかじめネットで予約しといたんだ。
lines.en: Yeah, yesterday. I had pre-ordered it online beforehand.
lines.style: Casual relaxed teen boy, slightly proud tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、ちゃんと準備してるじゃん。ゲームのオタクって感じ全開だね(笑)
lines.en: Wow, you really planned ahead. Total game-otaku energy haha!
lines.style: Teasing playful teen girl, laughing slightly

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うるさいなぁ。でもこれで例の新作、ひたすらやり込めるよ。
lines.en: Oh shut up. But now I can grind that new game endlessly.
lines.style: Defensive but cheerful teen boy, mock annoyed

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私もやりたい!けど親がものすごく厳しくて、もうあきらめモード。
lines.en: I wanna play too! But my parents are crazy strict, totally giving up.
lines.style: Whiny dramatic teen girl, exaggerated sighing

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジで?昨日のアプデでキャラ追加されたの、ビックリするくらい強いんだよ。
lines.en: Seriously? The character added in yesterday's update is shockingly strong.
lines.style: Excited teen boy geeking out, fast-paced delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 聞きたくなーい!とりわけ新キャラの話はナシで!バス来たよ、乗ろ!
lines.en: Don't wanna hear it! Especially no new character spoilers! Bus is here, let's go!
lines.style: Dramatic teen girl covering ears, then bright invitation
